headline: Junk today, but a clean solid day is loading for Thursday.
today: Prime SE angle but it's small and the wind is cross-on to onshore all day at 13-14mph. Peaks are soft and the surface is textured — nothing worth the drive out east. Wait for the wind to swing north midweek.

daysToWatch.note: Big jump on the swell model (up to 5-6ft) but the wind is 19mph SE cross-on/onshore in the morning — expect blown-out and messy. Afternoon eases to 10mph but stays onshore. High size, low quality.
The one to target. Solid 2.6-3.6ft at a prime angle with N offshore and cross-off winds all day. Clean and punchy — bring the shortboard and rearrange plans if you can.
Still fun — chest-high (2.6-2.9ft) at a longer 6.3-6.6s with N offshore in the morning going light by evening. Another clean session, shortboard or fish.
